newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldiers kill Palestinian assailant.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldiers kill Palestinian assailant.

text.p: Israeli troops shot dead a Palestinian who stabbed a soldier outside a Jewish settlement in the West Bank on Tuesday, security sources and settlers said.
They said soldiers had detained Palestinians in a car outside the Elon Moreh settlement near Nablus when one of the passengers got out and stabbed a soldier. Other troops shot the assailant.
Security sources had said earlier that the Palestinian knifed Israelis inside the settlement before being shot dead.
The injured soldier was lightly wounded in the shoulder, the sources said. The army said it was checking the report.
Around 130,000 Jewish settlers live among one million Palestinians in the West Bank which Israel captured in the 1967 Middle East war.
